{{short description|Nigerian professor of Biology|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Anya Oko Anya''' (born 3 January 1937) is a [[Nigerian people|Nigerian]] professor of Biology who is distinguished for his work in [[parasitology]].

== Early life ==

Anya Oko Anya was born on 3 January 1937<ref>{{Cite news |date=2020-01-14 |title=Anya: Uncommon academic, technocrat |url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2020/01/anya-uncommon-academic-technocrat/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2022-03-06 |newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-US}}</ref> at [[Abiriba]], [[Abia State]] of Nigeria.
He attended [[Hope Waddell Training Institution]], Calabar, University College, Ibadan, [[Saint John's College, Cambridge]], England  and [[Molteno Institute for Research in Parasitology|Molteno Institute of Biology and Parasitology]].<ref>{{cite journal
 |url=http://www.thisdaylive.com/articles/another-honour-for-anya/72286/ 
 |title=Thisdaylive honour Anya 
 |journal=[[ThisDay]] 
 |author=Idowu Sowunmi 
 |date=11 Dec 2010 
 |accessdate=2011-09-06 
 |url-status=dead 
 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120316214938/http://www.thisdaylive.com/articles/another-honour-for-anya/72286/ 
 |archivedate=2012-03-16 
}}</ref>

He began his working career as a Science Master with Qua-Iboe Mission Secondary School, Etinan, Akwa Ibom State in 1957.
He was appointed Research Officer, Federal Fisheries Research Service, Lagos, 1961–1962;<ref>{{Cite news|title=Anya: Uncommon academic, technocrat|url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2020/01/anya-uncommon-academic-technocrat/|location=Lagos, Nigeria|date=2020-01-14|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-US|access-date=2020-05-25}}</ref> Lecturer, Federal Science School, Lagos, 1961–1962;<ref>{{Cite web|title=Exclusive: Why Nigerian Government is in trouble – Prof Anya|url=https://realnewsmagazine.net/featured/exclusive-why-nigerian-government-is-in-trouble-prof-anya/|last=publisher|website=Realnews Magazine|language=en-US|access-date=2020-05-25}}</ref> Research Officer, Federal Department of Agricultural Research, Ibadan, 1963–1967;<ref>{{Cite news|date=2020-01-14|title=Anya: Uncommon academic, technocrat|url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2020/01/anya-uncommon-academic-technocrat/|location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2021-05-19|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-US}}</ref> Lecturer in Zoology, University of Nigeria, Nsukka, 1965–1967;<ref>{{Cite web|last=Admin|date=2016-11-15|title=ANYA, Prof. Anya|url=https://blerf.org/index.php/biography/anya-prof-anya/|access-date=2021-05-20|website=Biographical Legacy and Research Foundation|language=en-US}}</ref> Senior Lecturer, University of Science and Technology Project, Port Harcourt, 1967–1970; Senior Lecturer, University of Nigeria, Nsukka, 1970–1973; Professor of Zoology, University of Nigeria, Nsukka since 1973,<ref>{{Cite web|last=Admin|date=2016-11-15|title=ANYA, Prof. Anya|url=https://blerf.org/index.php/biography/anya-prof-anya/|access-date=2021-05-20|website=Biographical Legacy and Research Foundation|language=en-US}}</ref> he was the first chief executive officer of Nigeria Economic Summit Group Ltd.<ref>{{Cite news|last=admin|date=2017-04-07|title=Gowon, Others to Honour Anya|url=https://www.thisdaylive.com/index.php/2017/04/07/gowon-others-to-honour-anya/|access-date=2021-05-19|newspaper=[[This Day]]|language=en-US}}</ref> He was the Chairman of the Governing Board of the Nigerian National Merit Award, former President of the Nigerian Academy of Science and former Pro-Chancellor and Chairman Governing Council of the Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, Abia State.

==Awards==
Anya was awarded the Nigerian National Order of Medal of Merit (NNOM) by the Nigerian government in 1992.<ref>{{cite web|title=List of the Laureates of the NNOM, 1979-Date|url=http://www.nnma.gov.ng/NNMAAwardees.html|publisher=Government of Nigeria|accessdate=23 January 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131102183440/http://www.nnma.gov.ng/NNMAAwardees.html|archive-date=2 November 2013|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Anya has also been awarded the Officer of the [[Order of the Federal Republic]] (OFR) and made a Fellow of the Nigeria Academy of Science.<ref name="HoL">{{cite web |title=Professor Oko Anya Oko |url=https://hallmarksoflabour.org/dvteam/professor-anya-oko-anya/ |website=hallmarksoflabour.org |publisher=Hallmarks of Labour |access-date=18 October 2025}}</ref><ref name="Ndujihe">{{cite news |last1=Ndujihe |first1=Clifford |title=Anya: Uncommon academic, technocrat |url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2020/01/anya-uncommon-academic-technocrat/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=18 October 2025 |date=14 January 2020|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]}}</ref>
